basic_details.job_title: ASMC Bahraich to recruit 53 Faculty Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interviews start on 27 October 2026 and then run every Tuesday and Friday from 10:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Applications are not received after the reporting time of 12:00 noon. The venue is the office of the Principal of Maharaja Suheldev Autonomous State Medical College and Maharshi Balark Hospital (महाराजा सुहेल देव स्वशासी राज्य चिकित्सा महाविद्यालय एवं महर्षि बालार्क चिकित्सालय), Bahraich-271801. The college will fill 53 posts of Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in 24 specialities on a contract basis. The fixed pay is ₹2,20,000, ₹1,60,000 and ₹1,20,000 per month

age_limit.details: Candidates below 70 years of age may apply for contractual appointment to the medical teacher posts. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age.

important_instructions: The appointment is on contract (संविदा) for one year. If no regular teacher is available after a year of satisfactory service, the contract may be extended as needed, based on satisfactory service. A contract ends as soon as regular medical teachers become available. If service is not satisfactory, the contract may also be ended with one month's notice. Either side may end the contract at any time with one month's notice or one month's contract pay. Selected teachers must take charge at the medical college within 15 days of signing the agreement. Contractual teachers are not entitled to regularisation in government service. The agreement must state that the teacher will not claim regularisation or permanency, or any benefit beyond the fixed pay. Other service terms will be as set out in the agreement. No pension benefits or bonus are paid for the contract period. Contractual medical teachers will not be transferred. Private practice is not allowed on OPD days. Teachers who do private practice must state where they practise and must always be available at the medical college for emergency and disaster services. No teacher may compel patients to see them privately. The number of posts may be reduced or increased, and the notice is valid for 89 days only.

content_sections.heading: About ASMC Bahraich
content_sections.text: Maharaja Suheldev Autonomous State Medical College (ASMC) and Maharshi Balark Hospital are in Bahraich (PIN 271801), Uttar Pradesh. They are a state government medical college and its associated teaching hospital. The Principal's office issued this notice. The office's phone number is 05252-237621 and its email is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The table below gives the three faculty posts. The same qualification rule applies to all three: "As per N M C." The 53 vacancies are spread across 24 specialities. UR = General (सामान्य), OBC = अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग, SC = अनुसूचित जाति and EWS = ई0डब्लू0एस0. The notice says the number of posts may be reduced or increased. *The notice marks the Community Medicine posts as Medical Officer Health cum Lecturer / Assistant Professor (मेडिकल ऑफिसर हेल्थ कम लेक्चरर / सहायक आचार्य). None of the posts has a vacancy for EWS at the Professor or Associate Professor level. The notice lists the educational and other qualifications for every post as "As per N M C." Applicants must meet the educational qualifications and experience set by the Medical Council of India's Minimum Qualification for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 1999. Candidates below 70 years of age may apply for contractual appointment to the medical teacher posts. The notice does not print an "as on" date for age. Under Government Order No. 109/2024/176/71-1-2024/71-1001/804/2020 dated 18 July 2024, contractual teachers get a fixed pay of ₹2,20,000 per month (Professor), ₹1,60,000 per month (Associate Professor) or ₹1,20,000 per month (Assistant Professor). The college will follow any government orders on pay issued from time to time. Government Letter No. 250/2018/4067/71-1-2017-जी-63/2008, dated 20 September 2018, was issued by Medical Education Section-1, Lucknow. Under this letter, a retired Professor of a government medical education institution who is appointed as Professor on contract will get a fixed pay of ₹2,20,000 per month under the prescribed conditions. Apart from the fixed pay, contractual teachers are not entitled to any other pay, allowances, bonus, pension or service benefits. The official notification sends candidates to its NMC norms for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The service conditions are displayed on the Directorate General's website and on the college website.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed format (निर्धारित प्रपत्र) A demand draft for the application fee of ₹2,000 (two thousand rupees only), payable to "Principal, ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich" A declaration or affidavit stating that your services will be terminated if any adverse fact is found against you (to be submitted at the interview)

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Come to the Principal's office at Maharaja Suheldev Autonomous State Medical College and Maharshi Balark Hospital, Bahraich-271801. You can come on 27 October 2026 or on any Tuesday or Friday after that. Report before 12:00 noon. Applications are not received after 12:00 noon, and late candidates cannot take part in the interview. Hand in your application in the prescribed format with the ₹2,000 demand draft. Submit the declaration or affidavit at the interview. Attend the walk-in interview, held between 10:00 AM and 02:00 PM. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract (संविदा) for one year. If no regular teacher is available after a year of satisfactory service, the contract may be extended as needed, based on satisfactory service. A contract ends as soon as regular medical teachers become available. If service is not satisfactory, the contract may also be ended with one month's notice. Either side may end the contract at any time with one month's notice or one month's contract pay. Selected teachers must take charge at the medical college within 15 days of signing the agreement. Contractual teachers are not entitled to regularisation in government service. The agreement must state that the teacher will not claim regularisation or permanency, or any benefit beyond the fixed pay. Other service terms will be as set out in the agreement. No pension benefits or bonus are paid for the contract period. Contractual medical teachers will not be transferred. Private practice is not allowed on OPD days. Teachers who do private practice must state where they practise and must always be available at the medical college for emergency and disaster services. No teacher may compel patients to see them privately. The number of posts may be reduced or increased, and the notice is valid for 89 days only.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ASMC Bahraich walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews begin on 27 October 2026 and then continue every Tuesday and Friday from 10:00 AM to 02:00 PM. The notice is valid for 89 days.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: The reporting time is 12:00 noon. Applications are not received after 12:00 noon, and late candidates are not allowed in the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the office of the Principal, Maharaja Suheldev Autonomous State Medical College and Maharshi Balark Hospital, Bahraich-271801.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there in ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 53 vacancies in 24 specialities: 12 for Professor, 18 for Associate Professor and 23 for Assistant Professor. The notice says the number of posts may be reduced or increased.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The notice gives the qualification as "As per N M C." Candidates must meet the qualifications and experience in the Minimum Qualification for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 1999.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates below 70 years of age can apply for the contractual medical teacher posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of ASMC Bahraich faculty posts?
faq.answer: The fixed pay is ₹2,20,000 per month for a Professor, ₹1,60,000 for an Associate Professor and ₹1,20,000 for an Assistant Professor. No other allowances, bonus or pension are paid.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹2,000. It is paid by a demand draft in favour of "Principal, ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich".

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract for one year and may be extended based on satisfactory service if no regular teacher is available. Contractual teachers are not entitled to regularisation.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to any candidate.
